plate.narration: At the edge of the Bone Yard, broken stone walls stand among enormous pale arches. Salt wind moves through the gaps. A narrow path curves between the quiet ruins.

goal.text: Clear a safe way past the displaced ruins without taking anything from the Bone Yard.

voiceGuide.tone: Warm, curious and practical. Short sentences. Show the consequence of each plan. Nobody dies.

arrival.narration: At the edge of the Bone Yard, your Skupper guide from the flats stops in a brackish pool. Beyond her, broken stone walls have appeared among enormous old bones. Small bone crawlers crowd the fresh shimmer around the walls. "Clear a safe way past those ruins," she says. "Take nothing. Here, anything taken comes back. I will watch from water that suits my fins." One crawler is trying to fit its whole body under a pebble.

choices.label: Go on

limit.narration: The guide points out the boundary. Her pool is outside it; the ruins are inside. She lends a marked plank and a return line. Carry her spare mats as well and you can cover one loose-stone patch during the encounter, but you must carry and recover them. Leave them here for a lighter approach with no covered board patch. Which kit will you take?

choices.label: Carry the spare mats for board protection
Leave spare mats with the guide

pack_mats.narration: Level the spare-mat bundle before bringing it along the narrow marked approach. A bright loop shows which gear belongs to the guide, not the yard.

interaction.cue: Level the spare-mat bundle for carrying.

onSuccess.narration: The spare mats come with you. The guide keeps their empty tie at her pool.

onFailure.narration: The spare mats come with you. The guide keeps their empty tie at her pool.

onAssisted.narration: The spare mats come with you. The guide keeps their empty tie at her pool.

leave_mats.narration: Pass the spare mats back to the guide's pool. You keep the marked plank and line; your lighter kit will need to work around both loose-stone patches.

interaction.cue: Pass the spare mats back to the guide.

onSuccess.narration: The spare mats stay dry outside the boundary.

onFailure.narration: The spare mats stay dry outside the boundary.

onAssisted.narration: The spare mats stay dry outside the boundary.

survey.narration: The short passage runs behind a leaning wall. The wide rim bends around a hollow. Fresh magic draws crawlers to a tear near the wall. Check the moving shadow from this safe marker before choosing your working ground.

choices.label: Continue

survey_window.narration: Wait until the leaning wall's shadow clears the firm strip. The guide watches from her pool and calls the wider rim if your first view is hidden.

interaction.cue: Mark the firm strip during the clear view.

onSuccess.narration: Your marks show the short passage and a wider rim backup.

onFailure.narration: The shadow hides the short strip. The guide points out the wide rim first; you mark both from the outer bank.

onAssisted.narration: Your marks show the short passage and a wider rim backup.

survey_result.narration: Both routes are on the page. The wall may block the short one again, so the rim must stay recognizable. One crawler tries to look enormous on a very small pebble.

choices.label: Continue

markers.narration: Lay your own return line for a quick way back through a cleared passage, or memorize the arches with the guide. A retreat would leave the short line behind; her outer-rim signs work even then. Which return aid will you prepare?

choices.label: Lay a marked line along the short passage
Learn the outer arches with the guide

lay_line.narration: Pass your marked line along the safe strip. Keep it outside the crawling shimmer and leave a loose end near the pool.

interaction.cue: Pass the marked return line along the strip.

onSuccess.narration: Your line marks the short return. The guide still watches the wider rim.

onFailure.narration: Your line marks the short return. The guide still watches the wider rim.

onAssisted.narration: Your line marks the short return. The guide still watches the wider rim.

learn_arches.narration: The guide points out three arches on the outer route. Watch her landmark pattern before her raised crest disappears behind the reeds.

interaction.cue: Watch the outer-arch route, then echo it.

onSuccess.narration: You can point out the outer rim's three landmarks.

onFailure.narration: The guide repeats the outer landmarks with her crest signals. She will guide the rim if you need it.

onAssisted.narration: You can point out the outer rim's three landmarks.

test.narration: A yard pebble rolls back uphill over the boundary. Your marked plank stays where you set it. The guide raises a fin. "The yard is very particular about whose things are whose." Choose a small test without pocketing anything.

interaction.cue: Compare the yard's things with your own gear.

options.label: Nudge the loose yard pebble toward the line
options.reaction: The pebble rolls back uphill to its hollow.

options.label: Set your marked plank across the boundary
options.reaction: Your own plank stays put. The yard does not claim it.

options.label: Draw where the pebble returned
options.reaction: The guide checks your drawing from her pool.

onSuccess.narration: The yard's pebble returns to its own place. Your gear is a different responsibility.

onFailure.narration: The yard's pebble returns to its own place. Your gear is a different responsibility.

onAssisted.narration: The yard's pebble returns to its own place. Your gear is a different responsibility.

returning_pebble.narration: The returning pebble disappears behind three loose stones. Follow its marked hiding place as the stones shift, then point out where it settled without picking it up.

interaction.cue: Follow the marked pebble hiding place through the shifting stones.

onSuccess.narration: You locate the pebble in its old hollow. No specimen goes into a pack.

onFailure.narration: The guide points out the pebble after it settles. You correct the drawing instead of collecting it.

onAssisted.narration: You locate the pebble in its old hollow. No specimen goes into a pack.

vibration.narration: Fresh magic pulses from the tear. The crawlers all turn toward it; one bumps the next and tangles its legs. Tap your own plank between pulses to compare their response from the marked path.

interaction.cue: Tap the plank in the quiet interval between pulses.

onSuccess.narration: The crawlers turn at the fresh magic, then pause at your plank tap. You can plan around their path.

onFailure.narration: Your tap overlaps the pulse. The guide calls the next quiet interval so you can distinguish the two reactions.

onAssisted.narration: The crawlers turn at the fresh magic, then pause at your plank tap. You can plan around their path.

support.narration: A low brace will keep the leaning wall settled while you work. Roll a fallen yard stone into place and leave your plank free, or wedge the marked plank under the edge and recover it afterward. Caught gear must stay if you retreat. What will support the wall?

choices.label: Set a fallen stone and keep our plank free
Use the marked plank; recover it after the encounter
Have our thornguard brace while a stone is settled

stone_support.narration: Roll a fallen stone against the wall's foot from the open side. Balance it low and leave it inside the yard; the marked plank stays with your gear.

interaction.cue: Settle the low stone brace evenly.

onSuccess.narration: The wall rests on its own fallen stone. Your plank is free.

onFailure.narration: The wall rests on its own fallen stone. Your plank is free.

onAssisted.narration: The wall rests on its own fallen stone. Your plank is free.

plank_support.narration: Hold the marked plank while the guide calls its position from the pool. Wedge it low, leaving its bright recovery loop visible.

interaction.cue: Support the marked plank while the wedge settles.

onSuccess.narration: The plank holds the edge. Its later recovery will need a replacement support.

onFailure.narration: The plank holds the edge. Its later recovery will need a replacement support.

onAssisted.narration: The plank holds the edge. Its later recovery will need a replacement support.

braced_support.narration: Your thornguard uses a skill called Brace to hold the wall while a fallen stone is settled low. That saves the balancing job. The yard stone stays inside; your marked plank stays free.

choices.label: Continue

rest.narration: Back at the boundary pool, the guide opens a floating lunch box tied to a reed. There are soft seaweed rolls inside. You sit on your own mat outside the yard and rest. The box bumps her fin whenever she reaches for lunch.

choices.label: Rest at the pool, then choose the encounter plan
Rest while watching the crawler path

plan.narration: The tear keeps drawing fresh magic and crawlers. Clear the passage on open ground, or prepare the closing stones so the seam takes two working turns instead of three. If you carried spare mats, take an extra placement job to cover the northern loose-stone patch. The southern patch and crawlers will remain.

choices.label: Clear the passage on open ground
Prepare the closing points before the encounter
Place our carried mats over one board hazard

plan_1.narration: You leave the return line behind you and choose open ground for the fight. Nothing you strike will be carried away as a prize.

choices.label: Go on

seam_marks.narration: Share the positions beside the seam before the crawlers spread. The nearest closing stone comes first; finish at the point where your chime's echo can be checked. Your Listening Chime is the glacier travelers' chime: it tests readiness and a way back, not permission to change a rift's rules.

interaction.cue: Plan the closing-point approach from the marked strip.
clues: Begin at the nearest closing stone.
The firm side ledge comes between that stone and the echo check.
Finish by checking the echo point.

onSuccess.narration: The marked approach shortens the seam work to two turns; the encounter still has to be played.

onFailure.narration: The guide corrects the point order from the pool. The approach is marked before you enter; enemies and remaining hazards are still there.

onAssisted.narration: The marked approach shortens the seam work to two turns; the encounter still has to be played.

seam_marks_mats.narration: Share the positions beside the seam before the crawlers spread. The nearest closing stone comes first; finish at the point where your chime's echo can be checked. Your Listening Chime is the glacier travelers' chime: it tests readiness and a way back, not permission to change a rift's rules.

interaction.cue: Plan the closing-point approach from the marked strip.
clues: Begin at the nearest closing stone.
The firm side ledge comes between that stone and the echo check.
Finish by checking the echo point.

onSuccess.narration: The marked approach shortens the seam work to two turns; the encounter still has to be played.

onFailure.narration: The guide corrects the point order from the pool. The approach is marked before you enter; enemies and remaining hazards are still there.

onAssisted.narration: The marked approach shortens the seam work to two turns; the encounter still has to be played.

lay_board_mats.narration: Set the carried mats over the northern loose-stone patch while your friends support the outer edge. This covers that one hazard tile, not the southern patch or the crawlers.

interaction.cue: Support the mats while the northern patch is covered.

onSuccess.narration: The northern loose-stone patch is covered. Those mats will need retrieving afterward.

onFailure.narration: The northern loose-stone patch is covered. Those mats will need retrieving afterward.

onAssisted.narration: The northern loose-stone patch is covered. Those mats will need retrieving afterward.

mat_plan.narration: Your mats cover the northern patch. The southern loose stones can still bite. Clear the passage now, or also mark the seam approach to shorten its objective. Which encounter plan will you use?

choices.label: Clear the passage with one patch covered
Mark the seam approach as well

fight.narration: Bone crawlers clatter across the open passage. Close the tear by ending three turns beside it, or drive the crawlers away. The loose stones near the shimmer bite at anyone who stops there.

fight_seam.narration: Your marks show where to fold the tear shut. End two turns beside it to close it, or drive the crawlers away. Shifting stones still bite at anyone who stops on them.

fight_mats.narration: Your carried mats cover the northern loose-stone patch. The southern patch still shifts, and the crawlers crowd the passage. Close the seam by ending three turns beside it, or drive the crawlers clear.

fight_seam_mats.narration: Your carried mats cover the northern loose-stone patch. The southern patch still shifts, and the crawlers crowd the passage. Close the seam by ending two turns beside it, or drive the crawlers clear.

cleared.narration: The crawlers leave the passage and the leaning wall stops rocking. You have room to pass without climbing into the swarm. One crawler remains on a safe rock, determined to look enormous.

choices.label: Go on

variants.text: You closed the tear rather than driving every crawler away. With the fresh magic gone, they turn toward the stones deeper in the yard.

rescued.narration: The crawlers press you back to the route line. Your party pulls clear while the guide signals from the pool. You rest outside their reach. The narrow passage stays blocked, so the guide points out the longer rim path you can use instead. You lose the short route, not anyone from the party.

choices.label: Go on

inventory.narration: A carved chip lies beside the path. It would fit a pocket. The guide points to the returning pebble. "Your pocket is merely a delay." Check the difference between your bright-marked gear and the yard's things before leaving.

interaction.cue: Leave the yard's things where they belong.

options.label: Draw the chip without taking it
options.reaction: The chip stays in the yard. Your drawing records its shape.

options.label: Point out the bright loops on your own gear
options.reaction: The guide can distinguish her kit from the yard stones.

options.label: Brush a stone crumb from your sole toward the yard
options.reaction: The crumb rolls home. Your boot feels less interesting.

onSuccess.narration: Your hands and packs hold your own gear, not a hidden stone prize.

onFailure.narration: Your hands and packs hold your own gear, not a hidden stone prize.

onAssisted.narration: Your hands and packs hold your own gear, not a hidden stone prize.

unbrace.narration: Loose gear can come back now. A caught plank needs a replacement stone before removal; used mats need unfastening. You may recover accessible supports, or leave caught gear in place and gather only what is loose. A retreat blocks those inner recoveries.

variants.text: The crawlers block the wall and covered patch. Caught gear stays inside; the guide directs you onto the longer rim.

choices.label: Gather loose gear and leave caught supports
Replace the support and recover our marked plank
Unfasten and recover our used mats

replace_plank.narration: Balance a fallen yard stone beneath the supported edge before sliding your marked plank free. Leave the replacement stone inside the boundary.

interaction.cue: Settle the replacement stone before freeing the plank.

onSuccess.narration: The wall stays supported on its own stone. Your marked plank is free.

onFailure.narration: The wall stays supported on its own stone. Your marked plank is free.

onAssisted.narration: The wall stays supported on its own stone. Your marked plank is free.

recover_mats.narration: Keep the mat edge supported while another helper releases its bright ties. The passage is clear enough to reach them; leave every yard stone on the ground.

interaction.cue: Support the used mat while its ties are released.

onSuccess.narration: The mats are untied and ready to bring outside.

onFailure.narration: The mats are untied and ready to bring outside.

onAssisted.narration: The mats are untied and ready to bring outside.

gather_loose.narration: Pass your loose line, free plank and any recovered mats along the outer strip. Nothing caught under a blocked support is pulled after you.

interaction.cue: Pass the loose marked gear along the strip.

onSuccess.narration: Your loose kit is together. Choose the route that is actually open.

onFailure.narration: Your loose kit is together. Choose the route that is actually open.

onAssisted.narration: Your loose kit is together. Choose the route that is actually open.

exit_strip.narration: The boundary pool shines beyond the arches. The guide raises her crest. Follow her outer-rim instructions, or collect your short return line if the passage stayed clear.

variants.text: The crawlers still hold the short passage. The longer route is the way past it; a line behind them does not make it open.

choices.label: Follow the guide's outer-rim landmarks
Follow and gather our short return line

outer_rim.narration: Share the guide's calls to follow the arches around the hollow. Keep the boundary pool as the final landmark; you are taking the actual wide route, not reporting an inner victory.

interaction.cue: Follow the outer landmarks toward the pool.
clues: Start at the split arch nearest the inner approach.
The low arch lies between the split arch and the pool.
Finish outside at the boundary pool.

onSuccess.narration: Your party reaches the pool by the outer rim.

onFailure.narration: The guide repeats the crest calls until the outer rim is clear to follow. Your party reaches her pool.

onAssisted.narration: Your party reaches the pool by the outer rim.

return_line.narration: Hold the marked line while your friends gather its loose length from the cleared passage. It ends at the guide's pool outside the yard.

interaction.cue: Support the line as the party gathers it outside.

onSuccess.narration: The clear short passage brings the party and its line back to the pool.

onFailure.narration: The clear short passage brings the party and its line back to the pool.

onAssisted.narration: The clear short passage brings the party and its line back to the pool.

boundary.narration: A crumb falls from a muddy sole and rolls uphill toward the ruins. "Other foot too," says the guide. Leave the yard's tiny hitchhikers behind before closing the packs.

interaction.cue: Check boots and marked gear at the boundary.

options.label: Brush boot soles toward the yard
options.reaction: The last stone crumbs roll back inside.

options.label: Unfold the returned mats above the line
options.reaction: Loose grit drops on the yard side.

options.label: Check that the packs hold only your own kit
options.reaction: Bright loops and empty pockets agree with your account.

onSuccess.narration: No stone, bone or hidden prize goes out with your party.

onFailure.narration: No stone, bone or hidden prize goes out with your party.

onAssisted.narration: No stone, bone or hidden prize goes out with your party.

report.narration: The guide opens her warning board. Arrange the facts a traveler can use: the changing inner path, the checked outer backup, and the boundary that returns its own things. Whose enormous old bones lie here remains unknown.

interaction.cue: Build a useful route warning from what you checked.

options.label: Yard objects return at the boundary
Use the outer backup if blocked

clues: Begin by checking whether the inner passage is open.
The outer backup follows if the inner way is blocked.
At the final boundary, yard objects must stay inside.

onSuccess.narration: The guide has a warning about checked routes and the boundary rule, without a made-up history.

onFailure.narration: The guide checks the warning against your route and corrects its order. The bones' age and owners stay unknown.

onAssisted.narration: The guide has a warning about checked routes and the boundary rule, without a made-up history.

handoff.narration: The guide has her own route warning. An earlier note from Orin asks the Riftseekers to compare sightings at the glacier. You can authorize her to relay your written account too, or keep your copy for the next meeting. Which will you do?

choices.label: Authorize the guide to relay our account
Keep our written copy for a later meeting

relay_account.narration: Pass the account to the guide at her pool. It names the route you used and any gear left behind; it does not name who moved the ruins.

interaction.cue: Pass the authorized route account to the guide.

onSuccess.narration: The guide accepts the copy you chose to share.

onFailure.narration: The guide accepts the copy you chose to share.

onAssisted.narration: The guide accepts the copy you chose to share.

keep_account.narration: Choose a true detail to add to your own copy while the guide keeps her separate warning. You do not have to hand over your page to help travelers.

interaction.cue: Keep a checked detail in your own account.

options.label: Mark the route actually used
options.reaction: The page keeps the actual route, not a borrowed victory.

options.label: Record the returning-object rule
options.reaction: The note records the observation without pretending to explain its cause.

options.label: List any supports left inside
options.reaction: The kit list keeps any real loss visible.

onSuccess.narration: Your written page stays with the party. The guide keeps her own checked warning.

onFailure.narration: Your written page stays with the party. The guide keeps her own checked warning.

onAssisted.narration: Your written page stays with the party. The guide keeps her own checked warning.

ending.narration: Your party leaves the Bone Yard with no stone, bone or hidden prize. The guide keeps a checked warning. Old Ossley, the river boatman, will return upriver on the next tide; the guide has checked the tidal channel to his landing. More than one road lies ahead.

variants.text: The short passage stays blocked. Your account records the longer rim route you actually used.
The marked plank came back after a yard stone replaced its support.
The marked plank stays inside as a caught support. The guide cannot count it among her returned gear.
The used mats are back outside after the unfastening work.
The used spare mats stay inside. They are not silently returned to the guide's kit.
Your authorized account goes into the guide's relay.
Your written copy stays private; the guide relays only her own warning.
